title: Choosing a before or after photo loads every progress photo at once
what: When a member taps Before or After to pick another photo, the strip underneath draws every progress photo they have ever taken in one go, each read from the full-size original. With a long photo history this can make the sheet stutter or open slowly on a cheap phone.
expected: The strip only draws the photos on screen (and the next few) as the member scrolls, using small thumbnails.
how_often: each time the photo strip opens
fix_line: Draw the strip as a scrolling list that only shows visible photos

items.reason: these are phone app parts of the workout tracker; no panel web pages here (pagespeed.json covers the panel and websites)
no file in this area talks to the online database (no supabase, from() or rpc calls); data comes from the phone's own store
